title: festuca duriuscula var. crassifolia
intro: Festuca duriuscula var. crassifolia, commonly known as a grass species, is a type of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. The plant is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as digestive issues and infections. The therapeutic actions of Festuca duriuscula var. crassifolia include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
